control-size.$description: dimension used by the checkbox component for control size.

min-target.$description: dimension used by the checkbox component for min target.

gap.$description: dimension used by the checkbox component for gap (MarsUI md label pairing: Space/xl 12px for the 20px box).

radius.$description: dimension used by the checkbox component for radius (MarsUI Radius/radius_sm 6px bound on the box; Figma corner smoothing is an accepted rasterization gap).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the checkbox component for border width.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the checkbox component for label font size (MarsUI md pairing: body_2 15px for the 20px box).

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the checkbox component for label font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the checkbox component for label line height (MarsUI body_2 24px).

label-hint-fg.$description: color used by the checkbox component for the label hint after the label text (spec 047: the supporting-text role, a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI Input_label support text Text/low_em, which reads 2.8-3.13:1 on the onmars light surfaces; under more contrast it strengthens with every other supporting text).

label-hint-gap.$description: dimension used by the checkbox component for the gap between the label text and the label hint (MarsUI Input_label: Space/xs 4px).

bg.$description: color used by the checkbox component for indeterminate rest background (MarsUI Surface/primary_low_em_alpha: brand-500 at 20% light / 56% dark; the master defines no indeterminate hover, so every state keeps the tint).

fg.$description: color used by the checkbox component for indeterminate rest dash (Figma binds Text/primary_med_em brand-500, which measures 2.7:1 against the 56% tint in dark; one em step up keeps the 3:1 non-text law in both schemes — gate-driven compliant alternative).

border.$description: color used by the checkbox component for indeterminate rest border (Figma draws no border on the 20% tint, but the tint alone measures ~1.3:1 against light pages; the opaque brand ring keeps the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 control boundary — gate-driven declared deviation, same law that pinned ki.outline.control).
